items.title: Why customer trust is everything to Yahoo CEO Jim Lanzone
items.summary: Yahoo CEO Jim Lanzone joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss the importance of earning and maintaining customer trust. Lanzone reflects on Yahoo's 30-year legacy, the trust the company has built with generations of users, and why preserving that relationship remains critical to its future.
